test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The length of each side of a triangle is 12 cm. What is the length of the circumradius of the triangle?
solution: Given: The side of an equilateral triangle is 12 cm. Formula used: The formula for the circumradius (R) of an equilateral triangle is R = (a/√3), where a is the length of a side of the equilateral triangle.
